assetOrigin.description: External origin for DZI tiles and frame images. Must contain blue/, white/, dark/, night/ subdirectories.

providers.name: Vercel Blob
providers.notes: Store quackles-assets suspended; re-enable when budget allows

notes.manifestEntries: Logical paths only (e.g. /quackles-assets/blue/p0000000/3/{x}_{y}.webp). No baked absolute URLs.
notes.vercelTile404Expected: The Vercel static export does not serve /quackles-assets/*. A direct fetch of a logical tile path on the Vercel host returns 404. Tiles resolve client-side via NEXT_PUBLIC_ASSET_ORIGIN to GitHub Pages, where they return 200 image/webp.
notes.verifyTileCorrectly: To verify tile availability, fetch against the asset origin: https://kvnloo.github.io/quackles-assets/blue/p0000000/3/0_0.webp (expect 200 image/webp).
